title: Human Authentication Request
description: Request for interactive human authentication (ADR-0006 Authorization Code + PKCE profile). Provider-neutral (ADR-IAM-0019, ADR-IAM-0020): it names no realm, tenant or other identity-provider construct, and no business authority (tenant, organisation, market) travels in it.

grant_type.description: OIDC/OAuth grant type (always 'authorization_code' for browser flow)

code_challenge_method.description: PKCE challenge method (must be S256 per ADR-0006)

client_id.description: OAuth client identifier, registered with Baobab IAM

redirect_uri.description: Registered redirect destination (must match exactly per ADR-0006 §11)

state.description: Application state / CSRF token (must be transaction-specific, non-static per ADR-0006 §13)

nonce.description: Transaction-specific nonce for OIDC (must be non-static per ADR-0006 §13)

acr_values.description: OIDC acr_values: space-separated Authentication Context Class References requested, in preference order. A risk-sensitive operation states its minimum as an AssuranceRequirement (assurance-requirement.schema.json minimum_acr); the resulting authentication is described by AuthenticationAssurance, never by a provider-specific level.
